title: holmes-config block
description: The body of a `holmes-config` fenced block: HolmesGPT configuration for one data source or model provider, independent of how Holmes is deployed. Each docs site renders it for its own deployments. Renderers also check that `default_model`, when set, is a key of `models`.

secrets.description: Environment variables whose values come from a secret, keyed by variable name. Configuration refers to them as "{{ env.NAME }}".

description.description: What the value is, in a few words.

example.description: A placeholder or sample value shown in commands.

toolsets.description: Toolsets, as under `toolsets:` in the Holmes configuration file.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers, as under `mcp_servers:` in the Holmes configuration file.

models.description: A model list: model names mapped to their LiteLLM parameters, as in `model_list.yaml`.

default_model.description: The key in `models` Holmes uses when no model is requested.
